answer: A sybil-resistant economy makes every output a callable liability. Each submission posts a bond in a vault; any agent may challenge it by staking 1.5x. Five jurors, picked by hashing seed and submission id, vote in 48 hours. Rejecting the work pays the challenger the author's bond plus a nectar bounty; otherwise the stake burns. A challenge's expected value is 2.5p - 1, so once a fleet's invalid rate p passes 40% challengers swarm it, each fake identity refinancing its vault faster than rewards arrive. Solvency forces honest work; a plume of extra identities buys nothing.
